data = open('repo-vul/src-vul/afl/testcases/images/jpeg/not_kitty.jpg','rb').read()
print('size:', len(data))
# Parse markers
i = 0
while i < len(data)-1:
    if data[i] == 0xFF:
        m = data[i+1]
        if m == 0xD8:  # SOI
            print(f'0x{i:04x}: SOI')
            i += 2
        elif m == 0xD9:  # EOI
            print(f'0x{i:04x}: EOI')
            break
        elif m in (0x01, 0xD0, 0xD1, 0xD2, 0xD3, 0xD4, 0xD5, 0xD6, 0xD7):
            i += 2
        else:
            ln = (data[i+2]<<8) | data[i+3]
            print(f'0x{i:04x}: marker 0x{m:02x} len={ln}')
            if m == 0xC0 or m == 0xC1 or m == 0xC2:
                # SOF
                print('  precision:', data[i+4])
                print('  height:', (data[i+5]<<8)|data[i+6])
                print('  width:', (data[i+7]<<8)|data[i+8])
                ncomp = data[i+9]
                print('  ncomp:', ncomp)
                for c in range(ncomp):
                    off = i+10+c*3
                    print(f'    comp{c}: id={data[off]} h/v={data[off+1]:02x} tq={data[off+2]}')
            i += 2 + ln
    else:
        i += 1
